segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, so on the Tremont Manufacturing account, can I sanity check the handoff before I send it to services?

segments.speaker: Leo
segments.text: Yep. This is the 42-seat operations group, right? Three warehouse supervisors, rest are planners?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Right. They bought 42 seats, standard onboarding, and the data import is just items and vendors, no work orders. Go-live target is May 6.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Nothing heavy. SSO later, not in phase one. They just want the two admin accounts provisioned by April 22 so they can start cleaning the CSV.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, $18,480 on net 30. Billing tool shows the service line only lit through April 30, which is... close, but the services team mainly needs the import file this week.

segments.speaker: Leo
segments.text: Got it. I’ll keep the kickoff notes focused on the import and seat list, then.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Thanks. Also, Carl on their side asked whether training can be split into two 90-minute sessions instead of one three-hour block.

segments.speaker: Leo
segments.text: That’s fine. I’ll put Tuesdays or Thursdays as options and let delivery pick the exact slots.
